# E01 无穷小量的定义

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E01Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("无穷小量的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E01_1_1", "无穷小不是某个很小的固定数字，而是在给定变化过程中极限为零的变量。", "", tts_text="无穷小不是某个很小的固定数字，而是在给定变化过程中极限为零的变量。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E01_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E01_1_2", "需要同时说明变量怎样变化，例如 x 趋于零。不能只看函数名字。", "", tts_text="需要同时说明变量怎样变化，例如 x 趋于零。不能只看函数名字。")
        line_2 = Text("无穷小必须对应具体的变化过程", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E01_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E01Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("无穷小量的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E01_2_1", "当 x 趋于零时，x 本身趋于零，所以是无穷小。", "", tts_text="当 x 趋于零时，x 本身趋于零，所以是无穷小。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\lim_{x\to0}x=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E01_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E01_2_2", "但当 x 趋于一时，x 的极限是一，不是无穷小。", "", tts_text="但当 x 趋于一时，x 的极限是一，不是无穷小。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\lim_{x\to1}x=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E01_2_2")
        self.start_cue("E01_2_3", "固定的万分之一虽然很小，极限仍是万分之一，并不是无穷小。", "", tts_text="固定的万分之一虽然很小，极限仍是万分之一，并不是无穷小。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\lim_{x\to0}10^{-4}=10^{-4}\ne0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E01_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E01Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("无穷小量的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E01_3_1", "例题：当 x 趋于零时，x 平方与一加 x 哪个是无穷小？", "", tts_text="例题：当 x 趋于零时，x 平方与一加 x 哪个是无穷小？")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"x^2,\quad 1+x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E01_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E01_3_2", "直接求极限，前者等于零，后者等于一。", "", tts_text="直接求极限，前者等于零，后者等于一。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\lim_{x\to0}x^2=0,\quad\lim_{x\to0}(1+x)=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E01_3_2")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E01Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("无穷小量的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E01_4_1", "判断无穷小只看指定过程的极限是否为零，不看某一时刻的数值大小。", "", tts_text="判断无穷小只看指定过程的极限是否为零，不看某一时刻的数值大小。")
        line_1 = Text("变化过程 + 极限等于零", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E01_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E01_4_1")
```
